Reservation applicable for CPSUs is followed throughout. || Based on merit, candidates will be called fordocument verification. || After successful document verification, candidates will be given atraining engagement letterindicating the place of posting, date of reporting, and the scheduled date for contract creation at HRD, ECL Headquarters. || The candidate mustjoin at the respective place of postingon the date mentioned in the engagement letter. || After joining, ajoining letterwill be issued to the candidate from their place of posting. || The candidate must thenreport back to the HRD officewith a copy of the joining letter for creation of the contract on the portal, on the date mentioned in the engagement letter. || Theplace of apprenticeship training will be decided by the General Manager (HRD), ECL. || Mere completion of document verification or empanelment after the selection process does not confer any right of engagement as an apprentice in ECL.
